entries.title: Exodus 21:1
segments: Now these are the ordinances which thou shalt set before them.

entries.title: Exodus 21:2
segments: If thou buy a Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.

entries.title: Exodus 21:3
segments: If he come in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he be married, then his wife shall go out with him.

entries.title: Exodus 21:4
segments: If his master give him a wife and she bear him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself.

entries.title: Exodus 21:5
segments: But if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:

entries.title: Exodus 21:6
segments: then his master shall bring him unto God, and shall bring him to the door, or unto the door-post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl; and he shall serve him for ever.

entries.title: Exodus 21:7
segments: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maid-servant, she shall not go out as the men-servants do.

entries.title: Exodus 21:8
segments: If she please not her master, who hath espoused her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a foreign people he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.

entries.title: Exodus 21:9
segments: And if he espouse her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.

entries.title: Exodus 21:10
segments: If he take him another [wife]; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.

entries.title: Exodus 21:11
segments: And if he do not these three things unto her, then shall she go out for nothing, without money.

entries.title: Exodus 21:12
segments: He that smiteth a man, so that he dieth, shall surely be put to death.

entries.title: Exodus 21:13
segments: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver [him] into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.

entries.title: Exodus 21:14
segments: And if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbor, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.

entries.title: Exodus 21:15
segments: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.

entries.title: Exodus 21:16
segments: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

entries.title: Exodus 21:17
segments: And he that curseth his father or his mother, shall surely be put to death.

entries.title: Exodus 21:18
segments: And if men contend, and one smite the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keep his bed;

entries.title: Exodus 21:19
segments: if he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.

entries.title: Exodus 21:20
segments: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall surely be punished.

entries.title: Exodus 21:21
segments: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.

entries.title: Exodus 21:22
segments: And if men strive together, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart, and yet no harm follow; he shall be surely fined, according as the woman's husband shall lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.

entries.title: Exodus 21:23
segments: But if any harm follow, then thou shalt give life for life,

entries.title: Exodus 21:24
segments: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

entries.title: Exodus 21:25
segments: burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

entries.title: Exodus 21:26
segments: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, and destroy it; he shall let him go free for his eye's sake.

entries.title: Exodus 21:27
segments: And if he smite out his man-servant's tooth, or his maid-servant's tooth, he shall let him go free for his tooth's sake.

entries.title: Exodus 21:28
segments: And if an ox gore a man or a woman to death, the ox shall be surely stoned, and its flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.

entries.title: Exodus 21:29
segments: But if the ox was wont to gore in time past, and it hath been testified to its owner, and he hath not kept it in, but it hath killed a man or a woman, the ox shall be stoned, and its owner also shall be put to death.

entries.title: Exodus 21:30
segments: If there be laid on him a ransom, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.

entries.title: Exodus 21:31
segments: Whether it have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.

entries.title: Exodus 21:32
segments: If the ox gore a man-servant or a maid-servant, there shall be given unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

entries.title: Exodus 21:33
segments: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein,

entries.title: Exodus 21:34
segments: the owner of the pit shall make it good; he shall give money unto the owner thereof, and the dead [beast] shall be his.

entries.title: Exodus 21:35
segments: And if one man's ox hurt another's, so that it dieth, then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the price of it: and the dead also they shall divide.

entries.title: Exodus 21:36
segments: Or if it be known that the ox was wont to gore in time past, and its owner hath not kept it in, he shall surely pay ox for ox, and the dead [beast] shall be his own.
